paper_innovations.name: Blockified Pattern for DiT Sparsity
paper_innovations.description: First observation and utilization of hierarchical blockified sparse patterns in DiT attention, replacing traditional continuous patterns
paper_innovations.novelty: Addresses the fragmented structure caused by hierarchical video-text interactions

paper_innovations.name: Fused LSE-Cached Online Search
paper_innovations.description: Two-phase search strategy leveraging LSE invariance across denoising steps
paper_innovations.novelty: First precise online search for DiTs with <5% overhead

implementation.phase1: Fused Online Search (2-pass with LSE storage)

paper_innovations.runtime_representation: Get_Time(L, d, L) for phase1, Get_Time(L, d, L/2) for phase2

paper_innovations.name: Head-adaptive Hierarchical Sparsity
paper_innovations.description: Dynamic sparsity adjustment per attention head based on recall performance
paper_innovations.novelty: Addresses head-specific sparsity characteristics while maintaining load balance

mechanism.evaluation: Compute recall per head at base sparsity
mechanism.adaptation: Increase sparsity for high-recall heads, decrease for low-recall
mechanism.balance: Maintain average sparsity across all heads

paper_innovations.name: Training-free and Data-free Implementation
paper_innovations.description: Plug-and-play solution requiring no fine-tuning or dataset profiling
paper_innovations.novelty: First sparse attention method for DiTs without training requirements

proposed_improvements.name: Adaptive Layer-wise Sparsity
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic sparsity based on layer depth and content complexity
proposed_improvements.implementation: Reinforcement learning to learn optimal sparsity per layer

proposed_improvements.name: Multi-Scale Block Patterns
proposed_improvements.description: Hierarchical approach with variable block sizes (32, 64, 128)
proposed_improvements.implementation: Adaptive selection based on attention entropy

proposed_improvements.name: Dynamic Search Scheduling
proposed_improvements.description: Adaptive search frequency based on pattern convergence
proposed_improvements.implementation: Monitor LSE variance to trigger searches

proposed_improvements.name: Cross-Modal Specialization
proposed_improvements.description: Specialized sparse patterns for different interaction types

proposed_improvements.name: Hardware-Aware Optimization
proposed_improvements.description: Tensor Core and memory coalescing optimizations
